FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (UIET)
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160014, INDIA
Reference no. 3523/UIET Dated: 23-09-2026
ADVERTISEMENT FOR POST DOCTORAL FELLOWSHIP (PDF-01)
Under Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics & IT – Phase II
(Sanctioned by Digital India Corporation, MeitY, Government of India)
Applications are invited for one Post Doctoral Fellowship (PDF-01) in CSE/IT/ECE under the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme –
Phase II, sanctioned by Digital India Corporation (DIC), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY),
Government of India, at UIET, Panjab University, Chandigarh, for the Academic Year 2026–27.
Fellowship Details:
● Monthly Fellowship: ₹1,08,393/-
● Contingency Grant: ₹1,00,000/- per year (on pro-rata and reimbursement basis)
● Travel Support: Up to ₹2,10,000/-, as per scheme guidelines,
● Duration: 12 months
● Academic Year: 2026–2027
Eligibility Conditions (as per official guidelines):
1. Nationality: Must be an Indian citizen.
2. Educational Qualification:
○ PhD degree from a recognized university in CSE/IT/ECE
○ First class (or equivalent) in all preceding degrees
○ Consistently good academic record
3. PhD Completion Timeline: PhD should have been awarded within the last 5 years from the closing date of
application.
4. Age Limit: Upper age limit is 40 years on the date of submission of application.
5. Employment Status:
○ Candidate should not be in regular employment.
○ Candidates holding temporary positions may apply but must relinquish such positions upon selection.
6. Institution of PhD: PhD must not have been awarded from UIET, Panjab University.
7. Mentor Requirement:
○ A mentor/guide must be identified at UIET who:
■ holds a PhD; and
■ holds a regular academic/research position in CSE/ECE/IT.
8. Research Proposal: The applicant must submit a research proposal containing well-defined objectives, expected
outcomes, and deliverables.
9. Industry Preference: Preference will be given to applicants having:
○ active industry linkage; or
○ projects/research aligned with industry-relevant problems.
Application Process:
Interested candidates must fill the prescribed application form available on the UIET website and submit/upload the completed
application through the designated online application form.
Application Form: https://forms.gle/XZ4ZdXdbejvqdUxY9
Important Dates
● Application Opens: 23rd-September, 2026 (Wednesday)
● Last Date to Apply: 5th October, 2026 (Monday)
Terms & Conditions:
The detailed Terms & Conditions for the Visvesvaraya – Post Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) are available at:
Visvesvaraya – Post Doctoral Fellowship Guidelines
Candidates are advised to carefully read the official guidelines regarding eligibility, fellowship, contingency, travel support,
selection, and other applicable conditions before submitting their applications.
For Further Information: Panjab University – Jobs/Advertisements UIET, Panjab University
For any Queries: Prof. (Dr.) Mamta Juneja (Nodal Officer), 9878677624, visvesvaraya.uiet@gmail.com
